elektrotechnika.label: Electrical
elektrotechnika.heroLede: High- and low-voltage wiring, inspections, and smart systems — for apartments, houses, and commercial buildings, from design to handover.
elektrotechnika.overviewHeading: Electrical work you can rely on
elektrotechnika.overviewText: We handle complete electrical installations and inspections for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces — from initial design to a fully working system. We cover both high-voltage wiring and low-voltage systems (security, data wiring, smart home), so you only need one contractor for electrical work on site.

services.title: Design and installation of low-voltage systems

hero.title: Who we are
hero.lede: Tri-Grid brings three colleagues and three trades together under one name — from electrical through machinery to construction.

story.heading: Three trades, one shared problem
story.text: Tri-Grid is being founded by three colleagues who each have long-standing experience in their own trade — electrical, machinery, and construction. Working on shared projects, they noticed the same problem again and again: coordinating between trades often takes more time and energy than the work itself. They decided to change that and bring their trades together under one name, so the client deals with one point of contact instead of three.
